about: Each dealer's named trees (Jakob 2026-11-21: several trees per dealer, each with a name, about three at most; everything else is loose material that can later be deleted). A tree is a set of anchors from data/media-roles.json, by entry id: the root (A1) and the anchors it branches into, written in his notation by tools/dealer-tree.ts from the graph's nodes (IDLE = A1, READY = A2.1, READY-B = A2.2, READY-C = A2.3, a card node such as P4.C1 = A3P4C1). Films are not listed here: the tool finds every film whose first and last pictures are the tree's anchors. state: spelas (the game plays it), byggs (being made), vilar (resting). name is what Jakob sees and his to change. shares: the id of another tree of the same dealer whose anchors and films this one plays too; opening: a media-roles film outside the bank that leads into the root (the film before the game). An anchor may carry seat (1-7) when its picture is seen from that seat instead of the straight camera; the tool then writes S2-A2.2. seat is set only where a register says the angle. Read by tools/dealer-tree.ts, which writes its report to .runtime/dealer-trad/.
